name: grepDocumentation
description: Search the Confidence documentation content using regular expressions. Returns a list of documentation pages that contain matches for the given regex pattern.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for in documentation content. Supports Java regex syntax (e.g., '\berror\b' for whole word 'error', 'flag.*schema' for 'flag' followed by 'schema')

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching pages to return (default: 20)

caseInsensitive.description: Whether to perform case-insensitive matching (default: false)
